items.question: What is Twisted?
items.answer: Twisted is a Hack Club YSWS where participants make projects and complete a roadmap or pathways of challenges toward computer-related rewards.

items.question: How old do I have to be for Twisted?
items.answer: Twisted is for participants ages 13 through 18 inclusive and is available worldwide to eligible teenagers. If you turn 19 during the program, you may no longer ship projects.

items.question: Can I use AI for Twisted?
items.answer: AI use is discouraged. Twisted documentation says to keep AI assistance below or about 30%, with the FAQ describing a maximum of 30% AI-assisted code. Do not submit a heavily AI-generated project as if it were allowed.

items.question: What project types does Twisted accept?
items.answer: Twisted accepts software, hardware, and CAD projects. CAD-only projects are allowed. If a project does not reasonably fit one of those categories, a human organizer should review it.

items.question: Do I need devlogs for Twisted?
items.answer: Yes. Twisted requires devlogs, which participants post through the Projects page.

items.question: How many hours does a Twisted pathway require?
items.answer: When a pathway has a minimum-hour requirement, it refers to logged hours. The project must still eventually be shipped, and there is not one universal minimum-hour number for every pathway.

items.question: How many hours are needed for the Twisted laptop path?
items.answer: Twisted has a laptop pathway, but the required work is not one fixed number. It can depend on the item, project quality, and changes in item price. Do not rely on an old fixed laptop-hour estimate.

items.question: What is Twisted's reward rate per hour?
items.answer: The effective reward per hour is variable and may depend on the selected shop item. Do not use an old fixed dollar-per-hour estimate as the current rate.

items.question: What is a Twisted fulfilment bounty?
items.answer: A fulfilment bounty is used when a participant has not received their prize within two weeks after the YSWS ends.

items.question: Where is the Twisted help channel?
items.answer: Twisted's help channel is #twisted-help. Handle help requests there in threads.

items.question: When does Twisted end?
items.answer: The official Twisted FAQ lists the end date as TBD. Do not substitute a date from another YSWS or infer one from a launch date.

items.question: Does Twisted require solo projects or allow teams?
items.answer: No sufficiently authoritative current source establishes whether Twisted projects must be solo or may be completed in teams. This needs organizer confirmation.

items.question: Where do I submit a Twisted project?
items.answer: No sufficiently authoritative current source in the Twisted knowledge base specifies the exact project submission URL or process. This needs organizer confirmation.

items.question: Can I change my Twisted project idea?
items.answer: No sufficiently authoritative Twisted policy confirms whether project ideas may be freely changed after beginning. This needs organizer confirmation.

items.question: What happens after submitting to Twisted?
items.answer: The reviewed Twisted documentation does not establish a reliable complete post-submission workflow. This needs organizer confirmation.
